name: Cod Tikka Masala over Pilau Rice with Cucumber, Tomato & Mint Salad
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water, turmeric, and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring often, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Add tomatoes, cream, and sugar to the pot. Stir to combine the tikka masala sauce and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 4-5 minutes more.
While the sauce is cooking, pat cod dry with paper towels and cut into 2-inch pieces.
When the sauce is done, use a hand blender to purée until smooth. Alternatively, use a potato masher to crush the veggies (the sauce will be chunkier).
Return the sauce to medium-low heat. Add the cod and cook, stirring occasionally, until opaque and flesh flakes with a fork, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the shallot.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Trim and small dice cucumber; add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the bowl along with salt and pepper, then stir to combine the salad.
Divide rice between plates and top with cod tikka masala. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
